title: Locate a just-finished action or describe subjective recency

variants.label: たところ · just-finished stage

segments.role: たところ locates the current moment immediately after the buying action. This is the just-completed stage, not a general judgment that the shoes still feel new. Other ところ forms describe stages before or during an action; those are different constructions.

example.translation: I have just bought the shoes.
example.note: You have just finished the purchase, such as at the checkout.

variants.change: たところ locates the current moment immediately after the buying action. This is the just-completed stage, not a general judgment that the shoes still feel new. Other ところ forms describe stages before or during an action; those are different constructions.

variants.label: たばかり · still recent to the speaker

segments.role: たばかり presents the purchase as recent on the relevant timescale. It overlaps with たところ just after checkout, but can also fit 先月買ったばかりの靴, shoes bought only last month that still feel new. There is no fixed number of minutes or days that always separates the two.

example.translation: I have only recently bought the shoes.
example.note: You regard the purchase as recent; it could also have happened moments ago.

variants.change: たばかり presents the purchase as recent on the relevant timescale. It overlaps with たところ just after checkout, but can also fit 先月買ったばかりの靴, shoes bought only last month that still feel new. There is no fixed number of minutes or days that always separates the two.

question: The shoes were bought last month but still feel newly bought. Which construction naturally expresses that subjective recency?
answers: たところ · the stage immediately after the action
たばかり · recent on the speaker’s relevant timescale
feedback: 先月買ったばかりの靴 can mean shoes bought only last month. Just-completed たところ would not normally place you immediately after that month-old purchase.
